title: Missed Functional Capacity Evaluation Fee Amount — Workers' Compensation Referral
content:
# Missed-evaluation fee amount

**Standard.** A missed Functional Capacity Evaluation appointment under a Workers' Compensation Referral is billed at the program's missed-evaluation fee, once.

**Order of working.** The fee is worked out in this order: first the reserved-time fee is fixed, then it is multiplied by the notice share and by the cancellation-reason share, then the first-miss courtesy is taken off, the amount is never below zero and it is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Reading the standard

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| How often the fee is billed | once for the missed appointment |
| Shares | applied by multiplication to the reserved-time fee |
| Courtesy | taken off after the shares |
| Floor | the fee is never below zero |
| Rounding | half up to the cent, once, at the end |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- For a program whose missed-evaluation fee is $250.00, the missed appointment is billed at $250.00.
- Rounding point: a fee that works out to $41.665 after the shares and the courtesy is rounded half up once, at the end, to $41.67; nothing is rounded before that point.
- Floor: an amount that works out below zero once the courtesy is taken off is billed at $0.00.
